_comment: Hardcoded flagship supermassive black hole entries with Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) imaging badges. The full AGN/quasar population is loaded separately and progressively from the VizieR Milliquas catalog (see js/blackholes.js).

objects.name: Sagittarius A*
objects.notes: The supermassive black hole at the center of the Milky Way. Mass and distance from stellar-orbit and interferometric monitoring of stars orbiting it; imaged directly by the Event Horizon Telescope in 2022.
objects.source: GRAVITY Collaboration 2019/2022, A&A; EHT Collaboration 2022, ApJL 930, L12

objects.name: M87*
objects.notes: Supermassive black hole at the heart of the giant elliptical galaxy M87. The first black hole ever directly imaged, released by the Event Horizon Telescope in April 2019. Powers a relativistic jet visible across the electromagnetic spectrum.
objects.source: Event Horizon Telescope Collaboration 2019, ApJL 875, L1 (Paper I) and L6 (Paper VI, mass)
